mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) from the previous month to the current month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in months with FEDFUNDS decline > 0.1pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS growth > 12mo MA and UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (as indicated by GDP growth above 3.0% and CPI inflation above 2.5%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST declines > 0.5% in a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 3.0%, CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) from the previous month to the current month signals a contraction in manufacturing and services sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO declines > 0.5% from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market and weak economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based slowdown in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% from prior month, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), an increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) from the previous month signals an acceleration in inflation that may prompt aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
